items.title: Infants
items.desc: Warm, attentive care for our youngest learners, in a space designed around safety and sensory growth.
items.details: Constant staff supervision, CCTV-monitored classrooms, and a daily rhythm built around each baby's own routine.

items.title: Toddlers
items.desc: Guided play that builds language, coordination, and independence.
items.details: Circle time, Montessori-based activities, and both indoor and outdoor play every week.

items.title: Preschool
items.desc: A structured, play-based curriculum that prepares kids for the next step — including school entrance interviews.
items.details: Weekly English & Arabic and Math & Quran lessons, Montessori, circle time, outdoor play, and dedicated interview-readiness prep for school applications.

items.title: Teens Club
items.desc: A social and activity program built for teens.
items.details: A dedicated space for older kids to connect, play, and take part in age-appropriate activities and events.

items.title: Afterschool
items.desc: A safe, supervised place for school-age kids after the bell rings.
items.details: Afterschool care and enrichment activities for children already in primary school.

items.title: Summer Camp
items.desc: A summer full of trips, fundays, and hands-on themes.
items.details: Monthly trips, fundays, physical exercise, Zumba sessions, and educational themes running all summer.

items.title: Winter Camp
items.desc: The same trips-and-fundays energy, for the winter break.
items.details: Monthly trips, fundays, physical exercise, Zumba sessions, and educational themes running through winter break.

items.title: Extra Hours
items.desc: Extended care until 6pm for working parents' schedules.
items.details: Flexible extra hours are available until 6pm. Coming soon: hours extended until 10pm and weekend rotations.

items.title: Inclusion Service
items.desc: Dedicated support for children with special needs.
items.details: We offer an inclusion service designed specifically to support children with special needs, including shadow teachers.

items.title: Quran Sessions
items.desc: Regular Quran sessions woven into our weekly curriculum.
items.details: Alongside Math & Quran class time, we offer dedicated Quran sessions as part of your child's weekly rhythm.

items.title: Speech Therapy
items.desc: One-on-one speech-language support from a licensed specialist.
items.details: Delivered by our licensed speech-language pathologist, supporting communication development for children who need extra help.

items.title: Child Psychology
items.desc: Behavioral and developmental support from our child psychology team.
items.details: Our PhD child psychologist provides behavior modification support and developmental guidance for your child.
